summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests pass (42 cases), test/test_path.py passes unmodified, and the full test/test_extras directory passes (100 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed). Nothing is committed. Type checking (mypy) and black/ruff were not run because they are not installed in the prepared venv; type-ignore placement and line lengths were checked by reading the code and with awk (no lines over 88 columns). Two extra tests beyond the single parametrized test cover non-node inputs and graph immutability.
